settings.text: Help shape products, experiences and better outdoor spaces.
A Brand Still Being Built, On Purpose.

Good brands are not finished products. They are systems that become clearer through better decisions, better products and better customer experiences.

At TERBI, the opportunity is to help shape how modern outdoor space is designed, bought, installed, supported and lived in.
See the whole problem, not only your part of it. Follow work through to the outcome.
Make complex things easier to understand in products, decisions and communication.
Good ideas should survive contact with facts, users, testing and real-world constraints.
Build work that still makes sense after the launch, not just on launch day.
Turn real use cases into clearer, stronger, more considered products.
Build a visual and verbal system that makes TERBI recognizable without relying on noise.
Make discovery, evaluation and purchase easier across the customer journey.
Turn installation, support, parts and post-purchase questions into a better ownership experience.
Build durable relationships with channels, installers and partners who fit the brand.

settings.text:
We value people who ask good questions, challenge weak assumptions, care about details and finish what they start.

Titles matter less than the quality of the work, the clarity of the decision and the outcome for the customer. The best work usually crosses functions, so we expect people to collaborate without hiding behind organizational boundaries.
